text:
zoe-partners: FYI Gigabyte's PO via Oracle Marketplace failed final validation: signature rejected due to expired signer certificate. They claim their procurement used an automated signing service that rotated certs yesterday. Need rapid path to enable provisioning.

max-sales: Oof. Customer needs to go live for their promo tomorrow. Any way to accept the PDF copy of the PO or a signed email until they fix the cert?

li-platform: Portal enforces XML signature validation; if cert is expired, portal rejects. We could do manual intake into our internal billing system, but marketplace records will still show a failed onboarding.

eva-finance: We cannot book revenue or issue invoices without a valid signed PO. If we do manual intake, we need an explicit attestation from the buyer's procurement (email from an authorized signer) and to attach the original signed PDF plus a reconciliation note.

sam-legal: Legal won't accept a temporary workaround unless buyer sends an email signed by an authorized signer acknowledging the certificate rotation and confirming the PO terms. Also need to record that this is a limited-time intake for provisioning only, not a change to T&Cs.

marketplace-bot: Ticket created: ORCL-MKT-2219  signature validation failed (cert_expired). Assigned to p-support@oraclemarketplace. ETA 48h.

zoe-partners: I'll escalate with Gigabyte procurement for a signed email and ask them to re-sign the PO ASAP. In parallel, can Platform file a manual intake request form so we have approvals ready?

li-platform: I'll open internal request and link ORCL-MKT-2219. If finance & legal confirm the attestation template, we can provision in the staging account immediately and switch to production once Oracle clears the XML.

max-sales: Great. I'll push customer to get the attestation within 2 hours. Thanks everyone.

sam-legal: Drafted a one-paragraph attestation template and posted to the legal-templates drive. Zoe, I copied language: "Buyer confirms that the attached PO was validly executed and that certificate rotation occurred; acceptance for provisioning only; full validation to follow." Use buyer procurement email.

eva-finance: Once we have that email and the PDF, Finance will process manual intake under ref "ORCL-2219" and hold invoicing until portal validation completes.

zoe-partners: Attestation received from procurement (signed email). Uploading documents to the intake ticket and notifying Oracle support. Will update when portal accepts or support replies.
